description: An empty concert stage in a gilded, ornate theatre under a single spotlight. In the centre foreground a black clarinet stands on a stand. Around it are folding chairs with purple seats, brass instruments (trumpets, a trombone) resting on chairs, sheet music on stands with loose blank pages on the floor, a drum kit at left, a grand piano behind, and two double basses at right. No people are visible. The balconies are gold-trimmed with red drapes. No text, no frame.
